// netlify/functions/data.js // Questa funzione gira sul server Netlify. // Il sito pubblico la chiama in silenzio al caricamento. // Restituisce: foto gallery, testi ticker, statistiche social. const { getStore } = require('@netlify/blobs'); exports.handler = async () => { try { const store = getStore('woodreads'); // Legge i dati salvati dall'admin const [galleryRaw, tickersRaw, igRaw, ttRaw, ytRaw] = await Promise.all([ store.get('gallery').catch(()=>null), store.get('tickers').catch(()=>null), store.get('instagram').catch(()=>null), store.get('tiktok').catch(()=>null), store.get('youtube').catch(()=>null), ]); // Aggiorna le statistiche social se ci sono le API key configurate let instagram = igRaw ? JSON.parse(igRaw) : null; let tiktok = ttRaw ? JSON.parse(ttRaw) : null; let youtube = ytRaw ? JSON.parse(ytRaw) : null; // ── INSTAGRAM (Graph API) ────────────────────────── if(process.env.IG_TOKEN && process.env.IG_USER_ID){ try{ const igRes = await fetch( `https://graph.instagram.com/${process.env.IG_USER_ID}?fields=followers_count,media_count&access_token=${process.env.IG_TOKEN}` ); const igData = await igRes.json(); if(igData.followers_count){ instagram = { followers: igData.followers_count, posts: igData.media_count, following: instagram?.following || 330 }; await store.set('instagram', JSON.stringify(instagram)); } }catch(e){ /* usa cache */ } } // ── YOUTUBE (Data API v3) ────────────────────────── if(process.env.YT_API_KEY && process.env.YT_CHANNEL_ID){ try{ const ytRes = await fetch( `https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3/channels?part=statistics&id=${process.env.YT_CHANNEL_ID}&key=${process.env.YT_API_KEY}` ); const ytData = await ytRes.json(); const stats = ytData.items?.[0]?.statistics; if(stats){ youtube = { subscribers: parseInt(stats.subscriberCount)||0, views: parseInt(stats.viewCount)||0, videos: parseInt(stats.videoCount)||0, watchHours: youtube?.watchHours || '–' }; await store.set('youtube', JSON.stringify(youtube)); } }catch(e){ /* usa cache */ } } // ── TIKTOK ───────────────────────────────────────── // TikTok non ha una API pubblica semplice. // I dati vengono aggiornati manualmente dall'admin panel. return { statusCode: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Cache-Control': 'public, max-age=300' // cache 5 minuti }, body: JSON.stringify({ gallery: galleryRaw ? JSON.parse(galleryRaw) : [], tickers: tickersRaw ? JSON.parse(tickersRaw) : null, instagram: instagram || { followers:6157, posts:303, following:330 }, tiktok: tiktok || null, youtube: youtube || null, }) }; }catch(e){ return { statusCode: 200, body: JSON.stringify({ gallery:[], tickers:null, instagram:{ followers:6157, posts:303, following:330 } }) }; } };
